name: Darinak
backstory: Child of Darika and Darnakus in Salthos Cruzados; raised alongside walks the transit route's Salthos stretch at dawn..., having heard about Birth Of Dorakus.

experience.text: Grew up hearing: Had a child with Dornakus, named Dornarika.
Grew up hearing: Heard that Darnus and Fenserika now have a child, Fenarnus.
Grew up hearing: Heard that Nierius and Magus now have a child, Nieragus.
Grew up hearing: Heard that Nakus and Darnus now have a child, Darnukas.
Grew up hearing: Heard that Niemus and Darius now have a child, Niemius.
Heard that Darnakus and Niemoran now have a child, Niemornak.

criterion.standard: counts a life well spent only by making Birth Of Nakorika their own concern
criterion.wasted_life: treating Birth Of Nakorika as someone else's concern
criterion.trusts: a story that's been carried and retold and still holds together
criterion.distrusts: a record that insists on a precision no one who was actually there ever needed

routines.routine_actions: spends mornings finishing whatever patch job was left half-done, afternoons out on the transit route bargaining for stone at a fairer price than last season's

arc.premise: Darinak's picked up where his elders left off, and instead of chasing one agreed number across every office, he's started building an actual toll-recording booth at his own post along the transit route - a fixed ledger stand everyone has to use, so the dispute over totals has somewhere real to be settled.
